issues.claim: A matrimonial practice here since the late 1980s
issues.problem: The firm's own home page says it serves Middlesex/Monmouth/Mercer/Somerset 'since 1990'; the only 1980s fact is that Ms. Foley was admitted in 1989, and Avvo still lists her at a different North Brunswick firm. 'Here since the late 1980s' is not supported as stated.
issues.fix: Write 'a matrimonial practice since 1990 (admitted to the bar in 1989)' or 'practising family law for over three decades'.

issues.claim: each begins with a free 15-minute call from you
issues.problem: The consultation page says Ms. Foley 'also provides free 15 minute telephone consultations to determine the parameters of your case' - i.e. a free phone screen is offered before an in-office consultation. It does not state that every enquiry starts with one.
issues.fix: Reword: 'a free 15-minute phone consultation is available before any in-office meeting'.

issues.claim: no form, scheduler or after-hours message
issues.problem: Form and scheduler absence is verifiable from the site; whether the phone line has an after-hours greeting or voicemail is not publicly observable, so the claim overstates what was checked.
issues.fix: Scope it: 'nothing on the site offers a form, scheduler or after-hours route'.

issues.problem: Stated as fact with no source. It is an inference from the practice areas listed (domestic violence, DCP&P litigation).
issues.fix: Mark it: 'some of your practice areas (domestic violence, DCP&P) are typically time-critical - our inference'.

issues.claim: no client portal, upload, e-signature or payment link ... so engagement letters, retainer invoices and checklists are assembled by hand
issues.problem: Absence of a portal/e-sign/payment link is confirmed for the public website only - a portal hosted off-site (e.g. practice-management software) cannot be ruled out from outside. 'So ... assembled by hand' is an inference presented as fact.
issues.fix: Say 'nothing of the kind is published on the site' and label the by-hand assembly as our inference from that.

issues.claim: fax is the only transaction channel
issues.problem: The contact page also publishes phone and email (efoley@efoleyfirm.com), so fax is not the only channel for sending documents.
issues.fix: Say 'fax is the only document-processing channel listed' or 'no portal, upload, e-sign or payment link; documents go by email or fax'.

issues.claim: and keep Google, Avvo, Lawyers.com and Yelp matching Suite W21
issues.problem: Avvo (2875 Route 1, North Brunswick) and Lawyers.com ('1 Unknown, North Brunswick 08902') do disagree with the firm's address, but Yelp has no listing for the firm at all, so there is nothing there to keep matching; also the site writes 'W21', not 'Suite W21'.
issues.fix: Write 'correct Avvo and Lawyers.com, which still show North Brunswick addresses, and create/claim a Yelp listing at 330 Milltown Road, W21'.

issues.claim: It runs on what you already use - host, Word templates, calendar, email.
issues.problem: No source shows she uses Word templates or a shared calendar; only the host, email address and phone are evidenced.
issues.fix: Write 'on tools a practice already has - your existing site host, your document templates, a calendar and email'.

issues.problem: Body (title to the closing disclaimer) is roughly 476 words by word count, a little over the ~450 target; prose only would be ~449.
issues.fix: Trim ~25 words - the bracketed assumption text in section 1 is the easiest cut.
